svg.aria-label: Queen 2.3.0 end-to-end p99 against the partition count from 10 to 10,000,000 on three GCP nodes with local NVMe: at 3,000,000 msg/s of 256-byte messages 78, 65, 56, 66, 71, 47 and 54 ms; at 1,000,000 msg/s of 1 KB messages 68, 34, 27, 28, 27, 29 and 65 ms.
